title: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in Rymera Web Co Product…
description: A path traversal vulnerability exists in Rymera Web Co's Product Feed PRO for WooCommerce plugin, allowing an attacker with limited privileges to potentially cause a denial of service. The issue affects versions up to 13.5.8. No data indicates compromise of confidentiality or integrity, but availability impact is rated high.
